Definition: Pau or Pai, a place in Edom
BiblicalUsage: Pau, also called Pai, is the capital city of Hadar, king of Edom, named in the genealogy of Esau's descendants. Its site is uncertain today, and Scripture mentions it only in these two records.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a lost city matters to God: He records the kings and capitals of Edom just as carefully as those of Israel.
